forecast.reinvestment_rationale: CapEx starts at 2.81% of revenue from the recency-weighted 3-year audited level (latest year 3.06%, simple average 2.78%) and fades to a 5.20% steady state by year 5, where net reinvestment equals 2.50% terminal growth / 30.0% return on new capital (base roic capped) = 8.3% of NOPAT; D&A is held at 2.81% (reported); working capital at -5.86% of incremental revenue (working_capital_days); SBC at 3.09% of revenue is already expensed in EBIT, so UFCF treats it as a cash cost.
